pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto chabbaggiyehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍanakato hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.3: so sañcetanikaṃ sukkavisaṭṭhiāpattiṃ āpajjitvā saṃghaṃ tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.4: tassa saṃgho tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ adāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.5: tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyaṃ aññatarassa pūgassa saṃghabhattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.7: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū te upāsake etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.8: eso āvuso āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto tumhākaṃ sambhāvito kulūpako yen' eva hatthena saddhādeyyaṃ bhuñjati ten' eva hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocesi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.9: so sañcetanikaṃ sukkavisaṭṭhiāpattiṃ āpajjitvā saṃghaṃ tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ yāci,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.10: tassa saṃgho tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ adāsi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.12: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.13: kathañ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhussa duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ anupasampannassa ārocessantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.14: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave bhikkhussa duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ anupasampannassa ārocethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.17: kathañ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā bhikkhussa . . . ārocessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.18: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.19: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.20.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ anupasampannassa āroceyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.8: cattāri ca pārājikāni terasa ca saṃghādisesā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.10: bhikkhuñ ca bhikkhuniñ ca ṭhapetvā avaseso anupasampanno nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.12: āroceyya itthiyā vā purisassa vā gahaṭṭhassa vā pabbajitassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.16: atthi bhikkhusammuti kulapariyantā na āpattipariyantā, atthi bhikkhusammuti āpattipariyantā ca kulapariyantā ca, atthi bhikkhusammuti n' eva āpattipariyantā na kulapariyantā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.18: āpattiyo pariggahitāyo honti ettakāhi āpattīhi ārocetabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.20: kulāni pariggahitāni honti ettakesu kulesu ārocetabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.22: āpattiyo ca pariggahitāyo honti kulāni ca pariggahitāni honti ettakāhi āpattīhi ettakesu kulesu ārocetabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.23: n' eva āpattipariyantā na kulapariyantā nāma
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.24: āpattiyo ca apariggahitāyo honti kulāni ca apariggahitāni honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.25.1: āpattipariyante yā āpattiyo pariggahitāyo honti tā āpattiyo ṭhapetvā aññāhi āpattīhi āroceti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.26: kulapariyante yāni kulāni pariggahitāni honti tāni kulāni ṭhapetvā aññesu kulesu āroceti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.27: āpattipariyante ca kulapariyante ca yā āpattiyo pariggahitāyo honti tā āpattiyo ṭhapetvā yāni kulāni pariggahitāni honti tāni kulāni ṭhapetvā aññāhi āpattīhi aññesu kulesu āroceti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.28: n' eva āpattipariyante na kulapariyante anāpatti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.2.1: duṭṭhullāya āpattiyā duṭṭhullāpattisaññī anupasampannassa āroceti aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.2.2: duṭṭhullāya āpattiyā vematiko an. ār. aññ. bh., āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.2.3: duṭṭhullāya āpattiyā aduṭṭhullāpattisaññī an. ār. aññ. bh., āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.2.5: anupasampannassa duṭṭhullaṃ vā aduṭṭhullaṃ vā ajjhācāraṃ āroceti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
